reviews.title: They get you on shipping
reviews.text: It does not cost $15 to ship one mixtile.

reviews.title: Crashed on placing my order
reviews.text: After going through all my photos and saving my work as a photo book. I went to place an order for the book and I had a message that it was working on the order and the app never came back and said it was done. I went back to the app and my photo book was gone and the order was never placed. I’m not sure I want to start over.

reviews.title: Difficult to navigate
reviews.text: As I’m not too savvy, I found the site difficult to navigate dragging photos on the Web. It was easier choosing photos on the mobile app, but couldn’t include gift note.

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: The option to crop sucks, the fact that we can’t actually speak to a real live person sucks as well

reviews.title: Useless for Travel Books!
reviews.text: The app is absolutely useless.  You want to make those cool travel photo books with the pretty covers?? Can’t do it on the app! I spent a bunch of time creating a photo book only to find out I can’t get the cool cover. THEN when I logged in on the website my photo book (THAT I JUST SPENT SO MUCH TIME PERFECTING!!) doesn’t transfer to the website. AND you can’t add multiple different books to your cart in the app which means you can’t get the discounts. Beyond frustrating!! Honestly not sure where all these positive reviews are coming from because the app is absolutely useless for photo books.

reviews.title: More than one book, nope
reviews.text: These books seem super cool, but I can’t make more than one at a time.  I’d like to save the three I was working on and work on them together but you can’t seem to do that.

reviews.title: Limited function on app
reviews.text: Can only get cool graphic covers online, not through app. Didn't know until after purchase. :(

reviews.title: Orders take forever
reviews.text: It took 20 minutes for my order to process. I don’t like that

reviews.title: Needs updates
reviews.text: The application does not work well and needs better design

reviews.title: Not pleased
reviews.text: Could not add additional photos. App and online account didn’t connect. I didn’t find it easy to use the app and at a certain point it just wouldn’t let me add more photos. Super annoying

reviews.title: How Does This App Not Save Drafts?
reviews.text: I spent an hour selecting and arranging photos for a photo book only to have my progress disappear. After contacting support, I learned the mobile app doesn’t save drafts. Not saving drafts on the mobile app is a major oversight.

reviews.title: Mixtiles are great. This app is junk.
reviews.text: The Mixtiles are great. The app is a dumpster fire. Can’t easily delete things if you change your mind. The app randomly tries to make “picture books” of your photos (even if you don’t want them). Did anyone test this out before putting in the App Store?

reviews.title: Constant shutdown
reviews.text: Every time I use this app it shuts down and kicks me out every 3 minutes probably. I am rushing to upload my photos and do my edits before it kicks me off. This is a professional business. Do better, the photos are prints are great. The process is Extremely difficult and the app sucks.

reviews.title: The app won’t open on my iPhone.
App NOT user friendly
reviews.text: I was really excited to get my Mixtiles. I received a gift card and made an account online…however the website kept crashing so I thought download the app would help. I was wrong the app was worse and NONE of my progress would save! This wouldn’t have been a big problem to me if I didn’t have to edit all 32 photos over and over again! Not to mention by the time I was ready to use my gift card it wouldn’t save! I also really like the wall signs Mixtiles offers but it wouldn’t give me the option to select one! It wanted me to make two separate purchases which I thought was so dumb! Needless to say I spent 4 hours wasting my time on the website and app I don’t think I’ll ever use this company again but I do like my photos. It’s just not worth the amounts of time and effort. They need to make their app and website easier to navigate!
